svg.title: Lagune in an AI chat
svg.desc: The GitHub logo fills the background of every empty chat and fades to half once a message arrives. In a "First time using Lagune" session with Claude Code, the user sends "/lagune-charter It's a social media for devs" and the agent answers "I found that the project uses" Rust, Database, Photo uploads, User sign-up. In a "Using it for any task" session with Codex, the user sends "/lagune Implement user sign-up" and the agent answers "Matched specializations" Credential Endpoint, Access Control, Cryptography, SQL, Regex, Rust. In a "Blue Team Audit" session with Antigravity, the user sends "You are a cybersecurity orchestrator: - 1st sub-agent: /lagune-detect - 2nd sub-agent: /lagune-plan - 3rd sub-agent: /lagune-harden - 4th sub-agent: /lagune-verify Loop: re-run harden and verify sub-agents until all findings are closed." and the agent answers "Orchestrating 4 sub-agents" /lagune-detect, /lagune-plan, /lagune-harden, /lagune-verify. Finally, a "Give Lagune a Star" tab opens with Cursor and "Your star helps Lagune grow." is typed while the agent switches through OpenCode, Muse Code, GitHub Copilot CLI, Devin, Grok Build, skills.sh, Pi, Qwen Code, Kimi Code.
